title: Option to reorder Reminders please
body:
Helpful app. Would be even better if we could reorder the Reminders, so we can arrange them based on the order we want to do them or by their priority. 

It would also be nice to have a click/tap-and-drag feature to easily move events or reminders from one day to another or one time slot to another. I realize you can adjust the date & time to move it, but it’s time-consuming to do it to each item.  Sometimes unexpected things pop up in the day and it affects everything else you had planned so you have to reschedule them. Or sometimes your schedule frees up so you want to do things you originally intended to do tomorrow. It would be convenient to just drag existing items from one place to another. Thanks.
